_doc: Measured per-language, per-mechanism verdicts against REAL gold, the input data for carryover_eval.py's same-gold-type leave-one-out harness (plan internal-docs/aim1-three-track-evaluation-plan.md §2.6 E1). `verdict` = the measured effect counted as a real win (stemming: F1 delta >= threshold_delta; spanext: as recorded, see per-item note). `delta` = the raw measured F1 delta where one exists (null where the verdict came from a conflict-aware ledger rather than a single F1 number). `tokens_per_type` = target_morph.sample_tokens_per_type over the named ingest-cache edition, 100k-token cap (recomputed 2026-09-29 by carryover_eval's author, all 16 values match the plan's §2.3-2.4 tables). `gold_type` matters: a mixed-gold-type leave-one-out was uninterpretable in an earlier phase of this project (Swedish, lexicon-vs-positional gold), so carryover_eval reports per-gold-type numbers and labels any mixed one MIXED. `artefact: true` = the verdict is known to be a gold-convention artefact, not a real effect; reported with and without.

stemming.source: plan §9.2 / §2.3: whole-Bible (or gold-covered) surface vs --eflomal-stem eflomal, F1 vs the language's own gold; eflomal is unseeded, run-to-run noise ~1.3% exact_span
